Position: Lecturer in Human-Centered AI Institution: UCL Interaction Centre (UCLIC), Department of Computer Science, University College London (UCL) Location: London, UK (Hybrid working available) Contract Type: Permanent, Full-time Salary: £54,931 - £64,644 Application Deadline: 26 August 2026

Apply here:

About Us UCL’s Department of Computer Science (CS) is a top-ranked Computer Science Department in the UK. The UCL Interaction Centre (UCLIC) is an interdisciplinary research centre within UCL Computer Science focused on human-computer interaction, digital technologies, and user-centred research, teaching, and innovation.

About the Role The role involves conducting interdisciplinary research, contributing to teaching across undergraduate and Masters programmes, supervising students, and supporting curriculum development and assessment activities. Responsibilities also include securing research funding, engaging with academic and professional communities, providing student support, and contributing to departmental administration and outreach activities.

About You The successful candidate will require a strong interdisciplinary background in human-computer interaction, computer science, or a related field, typically supported by a postgraduate qualification or equivalent research experience. You should demonstrate:

•

Experience in teaching and supporting students at undergraduate and postgraduate levels

•

A track record of conducting high-quality research and producing publications

•

Engagement with academic or professional communities

•

Strong communication, organisational, and interpersonal skills

•

The ability to contribute to curriculum development, supervise students, and work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary environment.

Important Dates

•

Closing Date: 26 August 2026

•

Online Interviews: 15–16 September 2026

•

Follow-up In-Person Interviews: 5–7 October 2026
